name: Activity Monitor help
description: Help mode entries for the Activity Monitor plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Activity Monitor
entries.text: A live log of everything the console, axHub and every app does, each line in plain English: who did what, to whom, and what came of it.

entries.title: Search
entries.text: Finds lines with all the words you type: a name, an app, a build, an error.

entries.title: Time
entries.text: Shows only what happened in the last 15 minutes, hour, day or week.

entries.title: Level
entries.text: Hides the quiet lines: show everything, warnings and errors, or errors only.

entries.title: Kind
entries.text: Shows one kind of event: taps, actions, axHub runs, approvals, agents, builds, errors, fixes, rules.

entries.title: Layout
entries.text: Chains groups one request with everything that followed it as a tree; Lines shows every event in time order.

entries.title: Live follow
entries.text: Keeps the newest line in view as new events arrive.

entries.title: Pause
entries.text: Stops the log updating so you can read; Resume carries on.

entries.title: Resume
entries.text: Starts the live updates again.

entries.title: Export as
entries.text: The file type Export writes: JSON lines, CSV, Markdown or text.

entries.title: Export
entries.text: Downloads what the log shows now, with the current tab and filters.

entries.title: Activity log settings
entries.text: Opens the log's settings: colours, density, what to show and record, rules.

entries.title: Tabs
entries.text: All, Errors, Approvals, Agents, Builds, axHub, and one tab per app seen in the log.

entries.title: Retry
entries.text: Does what this event did again: reruns the console action, puts the build back in the Queue or reruns the systems check.

entries.title: Open
entries.text: Opens the thing this event touched: the build, the page, the run.

entries.title: Fix note
entries.text: Opens the Automatic fixes note about how this error was fixed.

entries.title: Whole request
entries.text: Shows the request this event belongs to and everything that followed it.

entries.title: Make a rule
entries.text: When this happens again, do that: notify you, run the fix, send it to an agent or run a console action.

entries.title: Test
entries.text: Counts how many recent events this rule would have caught.

entries.title: Save rule
entries.text: Saves the rule. It runs the next time a matching event comes in.

entries.title: Cancel
entries.text: Closes the rule form without saving.

entries.title: Delete
entries.text: Deletes this rule.

entries.title: Activity Monitor settings
entries.text: How the log looks, what it shows and records, and its rules, under Settings → Plugins.

entries.title: Activity count
entries.text: Events today and errors today; tap to open the log, tap the errors to see them.

entries.title: Chains
entries.text: Groups one request with everything that followed it, as a tree you can fold.

entries.title: Lines
entries.text: Every event on its own line, in time order.

entries.title: Who
entries.text: The rule only fires when this person, agent or service did it. Empty means anyone.

entries.title: Text it contains
entries.text: The rule only fires when the event's sentence or reason contains these words.

entries.title: Agent
entries.text: Who gets the event: the orchestrator files it as a build for them.

entries.title: Console action
entries.text: A console action to run in the open console, e.g. nav:builds.

entries.title: Systems check id
entries.text: Which systems check to rerun; empty reruns what the event itself did.

entries.title: Message
entries.text: What the notification says, or a note for the agent.

entries.title: Rule name
entries.text: A name for the rule; left empty, one is written from what it does.

entries.title: Events today
entries.text: How many events the log saw today; tap to open the log.

entries.title: Errors today
entries.text: How many errors the log saw today; tap to see them. Hover for the last one.

entries.title: Live follow by default
entries.text: The log opens following the newest line.

entries.title: One tab per app
entries.text: Adds a tab for every app seen in the log (console, axHub, AmberX …).

entries.title: Refresh every
entries.text: How often the open log asks for new events, in milliseconds.

entries.title: Record every tap
entries.text: Writes a line for every button, menu item, tab and row you tap in the console.

entries.title: Record every console action
entries.text: Writes a line for every console action, from menus, shortcuts, toolbars or remote callers.

entries.title: Record page errors
entries.text: Writes a line when the console page hits an error or a request fails.

entries.title: Events kept
entries.text: How many events stay on disk; older ones are dropped.

entries.title: Activity log: errors
entries.text: Opens the activity log on its Errors tab.

steps.say: Everything the console, axHub and the apps do shows up here as a sentence, newest at the bottom.
Use the tabs and filters to narrow it; Chains folds one request and everything that followed it.
Select a line to retry it, open what it touched or make a rule for next time.
